import fcntl
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import random
import statistics
import subprocess
import tempfile

root = Path.cwd()
os.sched_setaffinity(0, {2})
lock = open('/tmp/cp-wm-opt.lock', 'w')
flags = ['-std=gnu++23', '-O2', '-ftrivial-auto-var-init=zero', '-DATCODER', '-DONLINE_JUDGE', '-march=native']
paths = ['data_structure/wavelet_matrix.hpp', 'components/oct_bit_vector.hpp', 'components/quad_bit_vector.hpp', 'components/splitmix64.hpp', 'test/benchmark/wavelet_matrix_opt.cpp']
sources = {p: (root / p).read_text() for p in paths}
report = dict(reason='Recheck materially variable 1M-element kth results without source changes; retain the original cohort.',
    flags=flags, affinity=[2], warmup=1, trials=15, seed=81917, order_seed=20261020,
    sources=sources, source_sha256={p: hashlib.sha256((root / p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths}, results=[])
rng = random.Random(20261020)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='wm-large-') as temporary:
    work = Path(temporary)
    binaries = {}
    for name in ['before', 'current']:
        for path in paths[:-1]:
            if name == 'before' and path in ['components/oct_bit_vector.hpp', 'components/splitmix64.hpp']:
                continue
            dest = work / name / path
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            code = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', '523956f:' + path], text=True) if name == 'before' else sources[path]
            dest.write_text(code)
        header = work / name / paths[0]
        binary = work / (name + '.out')
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        subprocess.run(['g++', *flags, '-I.', '-DWM_OPT_HEADER="' + str(header) + '"', paths[-1], '-o', str(binary)], check=True)
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
        binaries[name] = binary
    for mode in [0, 1, 2]:
        samples = {name: [] for name in binaries}
        checks = set()
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        for trial in range(-1, 15):
            order = list(binaries)
            rng.shuffle(order)
            for name in order:
                row = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([binaries[name], '1000000', '50000', str(mode), '0', 'kth', '64', '81917']))
                checks.add(row['checksum'])
                if trial >= 0:
                    samples[name].append(row['ms'])
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_UN)
        assert len(checks) == 1
        report['results'].append(dict(n=1000000, q=50000, mode=mode, op='kth', width=64, samples_ms=samples,
            median_ms={name: statistics.median(xs) for name, xs in samples.items()}, checksum=checks.pop()))
        print(report['results'][-1], flush=True)
    for path, digest in report['source_sha256'].items():
        assert hashlib.sha256((root / path).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == digest
report['script'] = Path(__file__).read_text()
report['passed'] = True
(root / 'test/benchmark/results/wavelet_matrix_opt/recheck_large.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
